name: startup_name
description: Registered or trading name of the startup as shown on Startup India.

name: website
description: Company website, normalised to include a scheme. Null when missing, invalid or a social-media profile.

name: detail_url
description: Public Startup India profile URL. Contains the public profile slug.

name: country
description: Country of operation. Constant 'India' in this snapshot.

name: city_raw
description: Original city value, only populated when normalisation changed it.

name: industries
description: Industry labels. Semicolon-delimited in CSV; list<string> in Parquet.

name: sectors
description: Sector labels. Semicolon-delimited in CSV; list<string> in Parquet.

name: stages
description: DPIIT/Startup India maturity stage: Prototype, Validation, EarlyTraction or Scaling.

name: dipp_number
description: DPIIT recognition number (DIPP + digits). Null when not published.

name: cin
description: Company Identification Number, LLPIN or other registration number as published.

name: cin_type
description: Classification of `cin`: `cin` (21-character company CIN), `llpin` (LLP registration, e.g. AAA-1234), `other` (unrecognised format), or null.

name: cin_valid
description: True when `cin_type` is `cin` or `llpin`; false for `other`; null when `cin` is null.

name: listed_date
description: Date the profile was listed on Startup India (ISO 8601, UTC).

name: scraped_at
description: Timestamp of the scrape that produced the record (ISO 8601, UTC).

name: idea_brief
description: Free-text company description. HTML stripped, PII redacted.
example: Pigeon Innovative Solutions, is a Drone Survey company in India specializing in professional aerial photography servi...

name: id
description: Startup India profile slug; stable row identifier within this snapshot.

name: split
description: Deterministic 80/10/10 split (train/validation/test), stratified by first sector, seed 42.
